title: A person's approval of the live phase (bench.py plan refuses without one)
description: Written and signed off by the person paying for the runs, never by an agent. A subscription plan is not an approval: the same fields apply to any model execution.

permissions.description: what the agent may do besides the MCP tools (default: nothing: no shell, no web, no file writes)

max_cost_usd.description: the ceiling for the whole live phase; stop when reached

context.description: system prompt, context window, caching (cold per run or not), memory off

reporting_rules.description: e.g. every run reported, failures included, no run dropped
